Mia: Quick idea - rather than add another top-level nav, group Models / Deployments / Versions under a single collapsible 'Models' group with a compact second-level list. Sketch: https://figma.redwood/nav-compact.png :sparkles:
Jordan: I like the consolidation, fewer top-level items. Concern: deep links/bookmarks. Landing on /deployments/abc should still open the group and highlight the child reliably.
Sam: Proposed routing contract: keep canonical paths like /deployments/:id and /models/:modelId/versions/:verId (no hash). On client hydrate, map current path -> sidebar node, expand ancestor groups, then focus the selected item.
Henry: Accessibility details: when expanding, announce "Models expanded" to SR users, honor prefers-reduced-motion for any expand animation, and ensure focus lands on the link so keyboard users know where they are.
Mia: UX nit on breadcrumbs: show hierarchical names only: Models > MyModel > Versions > v1.2. Avoid repeating the group label or using raw slugs.
Sam: Implementation note: route->node mapping should prefer longest prefix match to avoid collisions (e.g., /projects/:id vs /models/:id). Deterministic tie-breaker: sidebar order. Also normalize trailing slashes and double-slash to canonical via 301 or client redirect.
Jordan: Visual affordance: do we add a subtle badge on the group header indicating current subtree, or only underline the active child? Poll: :thumbsup: badge, :eyes: underline.
Mia: Small a11y addition: the group header should be a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls; children list uses role="list" and each child is a link with tabindex. Add a skip-link to jump to sidebar.
Henry: Tests: unit tests for aria-expanded toggles and focus, integration test for route hydration that opens a collapsed group, and E2E for direct deep link landing.
Sam: Edge case: when a user navigates client-side between two nodes in different groups, we should animate collapse/expand but avoid stealing focus if user is interacting inside main content. Only auto-focus on initial route load/bookmark.
Mia: I'll assemble the PR describing the contract, ARIA rules, focus behavior, URL normalization, and test plan. Tagging @Sam and @Henry for code bits.
Design-Bot: Heads-up: design review scheduled tomorrow 11:00am. Please attach annotated flows in Figma by EOD.
Jordan: :thumbsup:
Sam: :eyes:
Henry: +1
